[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Margaret was born in 1793. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-649|Arthur Glasgow]] and [[McNutt-600|Rebecca McNutt]].  She passed away in 1873.

An agreement dated 19 September 1822 concerning Arthur Glasgow's estate names his daughter Peggy among the participating children and devisees. Margaret's cited marriage record also uses Peggy Glasgow, directly linking this profile to Arthur's daughter.<ref name="ArthurEstate1822">Arthur Glasgow estate agreement, 19 September 1822; [https://old.lva.virginia.gov/ChanceryImg/163-Rockbridge/BOX%20016/163_1833_005_0089.pdf Library of Virginia image].</ref>
